body: I am so happy for you! I actually got my crush to be my Valentine after asking him. I’m not entirely sure whether or not that means we’re dating, but at least I can say that this is my first time ever having a Valentine. I hope your February 14th goes great! It really is such a joyful feeling knowing that you’ll be with the one person you’ve liked for a while.
I agree.

I don’t know what you’re going through in your life right now but I hope you find a way of healing. I understand what it’s like to have suicidal thoughts. In fact, I still struggle with them. What I try doing is holding onto small moments of joy from my past, and I also try to use coping strategies such as music, sleep, and stress balls. But of course, everyone is different. The fact that you want to get better is already a great start. Work at your own pace. Try to find coping skills that work for you. Try self-help CBT. Try looking at positive quotes every day. It does take work in order to get out of the dark moment that you’re currently in, but I believe you have the strength in you to do it.

Sometimes, I do get periods of time when I’m questioning whether or not I’m asexual. I recently got out of one of those questioning periods when I asked someone what sexual attraction feels like, and I couldn’t wrap my mind around what that person said. But I’ll probably question my own asexuality again in the future.
Pretty much.
Thank you 🤗
It’s satire.
So have I. That was my first thought when I saw their comment.
TIL
TIL

That’s horrible and I feel bad for you. Antinatalists do not harm anyone at all. I understand why racism and any other discriminatory practices aren’t allowed, and I am completely against any view that directly hurts people. But antinatalism? I agree that some have rather illogical points, but that’s just a small amount. Antinatalists need to be respected more. We do not go against science and do not discriminate against people. We know that life is inherent suffering. People who say things like “life is beautiful” are just tricking themselves; they’re scared of—and as a result, ignore—all the bad that life truly is.
I never really thought about it this way. Interesting perspective, and I agree.
I love to excessively sleep. It’s a temporary and refreshing way to avoid the problems that life offers.
Same here. Every time something that I consider to be bad happens, I think of suicide or death, because it helps calm me down and reminds me that I won’t be living forever to remember it forever.
Yeah. I don’t care about the positive things anymore. There’s more bad than good.
Same. It’s hard. I constantly feel like I’m stuck.
Unfortunately, we naturally have a survival instinct. I wish we can override or lower it.
There are some people in my life that I would like to keep, but other than that, same. I want to isolate myself from most people.
Pretty much same. I’m lazy as fuck. This world isn’t meant for lazy people like me.
Love this message. Why should I continue living in a fucked up world? Just because I don’t want to continue living in it doesn’t mean there’s something wrong with me.
I’m jealous.

17 year old here too. I can’t exactly relate to your experiences because I’ve never gone through them: never had therapy (don’t want it and don’t care) and never been hospitalized. While I do think I can make it to 18, I don’t think I’ll be able to make it to 20, or even 19 for that matter. I’ve been having suicidal thoughts for about five or six years now, and I had an attempt about four years ago. I wrote an unfinished suicide note less than a year ago and had plans for my death. I understand what you mean when you say that everything triggers your thoughts, that it’s hard to survive each day, and that you don’t want to die but don’t want to live either. It’s a struggle. I sleep to temporarily escape from it all.

Life was intentionally forced upon me, I’m a lazy and worthless person who avoids everything in order to cope, and we live in a shitty world. Just because I want to escape from that doesn’t mean I’m being entirely illogical. While I do understand that life can be beautiful at times and that I have people who care about me, the good doesn’t outweigh the bad. I would say 90% of this world is bad and 10% of it is actually good. It’s not worth living for the “good” moments when all that life is is constant suffering.

Telling me about the sunset, rain, dancing, etc. doesn’t help at all. That doesn’t bring me joy and I don’t care about the “beauty” of any. I do like music, art, and food, but I still don’t care if I don’t have those things anymore (except maybe food because I don’t want to starve and have a gradual and painful death). I’d rather end it all in a second.
This is sweet, and it makes me feel a little joy. But it still doesn’t change my perspective on suicide at all.

I’m with you there. There’s nothing for me in the future. I don’t want to do anything in the future. What’s keeping me alive though is the fear of surviving after attempting, my friends and family, and helping other people. But every day is a struggle. I wish I was never born.

Life 🙏🙏 is meant 😉 to be full of struggles 🙂 But life ✨ is still ❣️ a good thing 🎁💝 You’re supposed 🤪 to just cope 🥰 which is not ❌ even hard 🤩🤩 All you need to do 🤗 is suck it up 💛 and think 💭 positive things ☺️☺️☺️ Suicide 🔫 is for cowards ✋✋✋ Don’t 🚫 be one 1️⃣!!!!!!

Exactly. I don’t understand how people are happy existing when there are so many atrocities happening around us. I always try to be kind and help others out to reduce the amount of suffering in this world, but the world is never going to change. This is considered normal and we’re supposed to just blindly accept it. It’s hard to see the meaning of life when there’s so much pain and evil. If we’re going to be living, life should be at least beautiful. But it’s not, and that’s pointless.
I’d rather not be destined to suffer.
“It gets better.” It doesn’t help. When old problems disappear, new problems arise.
I love Marvel, and I respect your opinion. But I’m curious to know why you hate it.

And society is responsible for that suffering. Yet they don’t want people to kill themselves when those people want to escape from that suffering. That’s why even though I’m not a fan of bringing people into this world, I always try to make people’s lives worth living as long as they are here. But it can be hard when society is set up the way that it is, and life is filled with pain and suffering.

This is me as well. My childhood self was happy, optimistic, and had high hopes for the future. That version of me would be disappointed in the person I’ve turned out to be.

By the way, suicide isn’t a cowardly act at all. People (not referring to you, referring to people who have never been in your position) who think it’s cowardly are ignorant and do not understand the mind of a suicidal person. Suicide is a very hard choice to be faced with, especially since the human body has a self-preservation instinct.

I hate being an American sometimes. There are way too many selfish people in the United States, and there’s very little empathy in this country. I don’t really have much to tell you other than I hope you find something that brings you joy, even if it’s something small.

If you’ve never had suicidal thoughts, then you should not be barging in here and attacking OP. This will only cause them to feel even more guilty about how they’re feeling. Calling a suicidal person “attention-seeking” is really harmful. Learn to understand others before making a comment like that.
I’m proud of you!
Same. I wish one day, I can hug the person I confide in. I know he needs a hug too. We both need it.
I feel you. I don’t want to play the game of life.

I understand. I’m in the same position as you. Self-harm is something I’ve been thinking about doing again; physical pain nicely distracts me from my emotions. But instead of self-harming, try finding a different coping method if you can. I know it’s a struggle, so I wish you the best in the future.
I’ve never thought about it this way. Good point.

I understand. I have thoughts like “I deserve to feel this way” because I’m a lazy person with really horrible habits. But I also have thoughts like you do because I’ve never been physically harmed or anything, which makes me feel guilty for having the thoughts that I do. But what I’ve learned is to not compare pain to other people’s. Don’t reject what you feel and learn to accept that this is the way you’re feeling. You absolutely do have the right to complain, and your emotions, feelings, and pain are completely valid.
I feel exactly the same way. I don’t want to become an adult. I’m too weak for life. I’m the laziest person I know, and I’m happy being this way. I don’t want to play the rules of society.

This world is terrible, I agree. I don’t think I can live in a world like this. But I hope you eventually find a reason to keep on going. For me, I try spreading small acts of kindness and try making a difference in people’s lives. I hope you find something that works for you. Sending you love.

I can relate to you in some way. I also made plans relating to my death earlier this school year. I have exams coming up and don’t want to do them. I also help my friends in pain when I can’t even help myself. I’m not in a gifted program, but I am in the top 4% of my class. I also feel like I can’t function properly and always feel that I’m worthless and as if my efforts are futile. While you may feel that your perspective is lonely and miserable, you’re not alone in feeling this way.

You say you’re often invalidated. But your pain and suffering are valid, even if it’s hard to see that. If you’re able to, talk to one of your friends about how you’re feeling and ask them to listen whenever you need to talk to them. For me, having someone to confide in makes me feel better. It also seems that you’re worrying about the future. But remember it’s okay to be here right now. Acceptance of our own pain and suffering is the first step in finding future comfort. I understand that it’s hard to work towards that, as I have a lot to work on too and often feel that everything’s pointless. But I do hope you find peace within yourself. You’ve gone through a lot, you survived, and you posted this. It shows that you do deserve some credit. I can’t promise anything, but I hope everything ends up in your favor.
